sentence: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever: / Its loveliness increases; it will never / Pass into nothingness

source.author: John Keats
source.detail: 长诗《恩底弥翁》第一卷开篇前三行

translation: 美的事物是永恒的喜悦：它的可爱与日俱增，永远不会消逝于虚无。
grammar: 主干很简单：A thing of beauty（主语）+ is（系动词）+ a joy（表语），for ever 是状语。“a thing of beauty”是“a/an + 名词 + of + 抽象名词”结构，等于 a beautiful thing，但更庄重、更有诗意，类似 a man of courage（有勇气的人）、a matter of importance（重要的事）。

冒号和分号的分工：冒号后面是对前一句的解释说明（为什么是永恒的喜悦）；分号连接两个关系紧密的独立分句 Its loveliness increases 和 it will never pass into nothingness，不用 and 也能并列。注意 will never / Pass 是诗歌的跨行（enjambment），读的时候要连起来：will never pass into nothingness。

vocab.meaning: 可爱，美好（lovely 的名词形式）
vocab.collocation: the loveliness of nature / sheer loveliness
vocab.example: We were struck by the loveliness of the mountain lake.

vocab.meaning: 增加，增长（句中为不及物动词）
vocab.collocation: increase by 10% / an increase in sales / be on the increase
vocab.example: The number of users increased by 20% last year.

vocab.collocation: pass into history / pass into legend / pass into common use
vocab.example: The word has passed into everyday English.

vocab.collocation: fade into nothingness / a sense of nothingness
vocab.example: The sound slowly faded into nothingness.

vocab.meaning: 永远（英式常分写为 for ever，美式多写 forever）
vocab.collocation: last for ever / for ever and ever
vocab.example: Good habits can stay with you for ever.

note: 小练习：用“a/an + 名词 + of + 抽象名词”改写 a very important matter 和 a wise man。（答案：a matter of great importance / a man of wisdom）
